content.text:
Finding submitted.

**RENEWAL — deviation (fallback target).** § 8.2 auto-renews each Order Form for twelve months but requires 180 days' non-renewal notice, which exceeds the 60-day fallback ceiling and sits in walk-away territory (>90 days). § 8.3 already caps renewal uplift at the lesser of CPI and 3%, satisfying the pricing element verbatim, so the only operative change proposed is shortening the notice window from one hundred eighty days to sixty days. The absent Vendor renewal reminder is a preferred-only sub-element, noted rather than flagged.
